answer.narration:
He's thumbing a fresh bolt into the chamber when you hit him low, the way your uncle taught you in the dock gym. You both slam into the deck. The bolt gun clatters away and skids under a cargo strap rack.

Vasko is wiry and mean. His knee finds your bruised ribs and the pain goes white, but you get your forearm across his throat and your weight on his chest. He thrashes, then goes still and glares up at you.

"You think they'll thank you?" he rasps. "They'll lock up the people in that hold too. Send them back to wherever they ran from."

The orange line on the hatch is a third of the way around. The hold is silent.
choices: Grab the bolt gun and hold him
Open the hold to free them
answer.summary: Waren Spacefarer, a young pilot with ten credits, wants forty thousand to buy the Kestrel from Marta Okafor. He took a relief pilot job on the ore tug Grubstake for Captain Dren Vasko, promised six hundred credits on delivery to Vesta. Vasko is smuggling people in the sealed hold. Waren tried to cooperate with Ceres Customs; Vasko punched him and shot the airlock panel, fusing the hatch. Customs is cutting through. Waren tackled Vasko and pinned him; the bolt gun slid under a rack. Vasko claims customs will deport the people in the hold.
